attacks.name: Monster Hunting Weapons
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Hellfire|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| and |§slow§Slow| special conditions.

attacks.name: Bloodgem Blast
steps: During the |*Pay| |!power| step of this attack, this character may spend up to three additional |!power|. Add 1 die to this attack for each |!power| spent in this way.
|!wild| |*Degeneration|: After this attack is resolved, the defender cannot have |!damage| removed from it until the end of the |*Activation Phase| this Round.

superPowers.name: Legion of Monsters (Affiliation: Midnight Sons)
superPowers.body: Once per Turn, when an allied character targets a character with an attack, it may pay 1 |!power|. If it does, the attack gains your choice of 1 of the following effects:|~&*Boom!&: Before &!damage& is dealt, each other character within &!range& 2 of the target character suffers 1 &!damage&.||~&*Horrify&: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the &§root§Root& special condition.||~&*Silver Bullet&: &!damage& caused by this attack cannot be reduced or prevented by superpowers or Team Tactic Cards.|

superPowers.name: Run and Gun
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action.

superPowers.name: Supernatural Senses
superPowers.body: While this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!mystic| attack, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, it may use this superpower. This character may reroll any number of its defense dice, including |!failure| results.

superPowers.name: Bearer of the Bloodgem
superPowers.body: When an enemy character causes this character to gain one or more special conditions, after the effect is resolved, the enemy character suffers 1 |!damage|. Additionally, this character cannot be Advanced or Placed by the effects of |!mystic| attacks or enemy superpowers.

erratas.body: Monster Hunting Weapons can now be made as either a |!physical| or |!energy| attack.
Monster Hunting Weapons's Cursing Shot (inflicts Slow on |!critical|) and Hellfire (inflicts Incinerate on |!wild|) special rules were merged to grant both Incinerate and Slow on |!wild|..
The timing of Degeneration special rule from Bloodgem Blast attack was updated to "After this attack is resolved" on 2025-01-03.
